desc: A daily light and shadow puzzle. Colour every cell light or shadow so the grid breaks into numbered fields, each holding one clue that says its size, and no two fields of the same shade sharing an edge.

name: Unblock
desc: Daily sliding-block puzzle: slide the blocks to free the target block. One new board every day.

name: Unstack the Cube
desc: A daily 3D arrow puzzle. Rotate the cube and tap arrows to slide them off, but only the ones with a clear path.

name: Unstack the Dock
desc: Think fast, stack smart. In Unstack the Dock, you clear a pile of crates one tap at a time, sending each to the loading dock while the orders roll in. Pick the wrong crate and the dock jams. Can you clear today's dock?

name: Wattsworth
desc: A daily puzzle about turning a day of sunshine into money: plan your jobs around a battery, the sun and the heat.

name: Wayfold
desc: A daily number path puzzle: draw one path through every square, passing the numbers in order.

name: Winding Path
desc: Draw one continuous line that fills the whole grid. Seems simple at first, but quickly becomes challenging!

name: Wirespan
desc: Route power from the plant to every house while optimizing grid layout.

name: AnimeGrids
desc: AnimeGrids is a daily anime grid trivia game. Fill a 3x3 board by choosing anime titles that match both the row clue and the column clue, then compare rarity scores with other players.

name: BingeWatcher
desc: A daily challenge where players guess a box-office movie based on a progressively revealed set of clues. Inspired by word association games and film trivia.

name: Byrdle
desc: Guess the hidden choral-themed word in 6 tries. A new puzzle is available each day.

name: Cast Six
desc: Match six movies to six overlapping categories in three takes.

name: Castme
desc: Guess the daily movie from its cast. See one actor, take a guess, and another castmate is revealed with each miss. Wrong guesses tell you if your pick shares an actor with the answer, plus year, genre, and director clues to close in.

name: Chordle
desc: Like Wordle but chords. Guess the four-note chord in four tries or fewer. A game for musicians!

name: CineLine
desc: Arrange films in chronological order. A clean, fast daily movie puzzle

name: CineNerdle
desc: Solve unique, grid-based puzzles designed to test your film knowledge daily, or challenge your friends, family or film nerds from across the globe in head-to-head film linking battles.

name: Cross Tune
desc: A musical crossword where song snippets replace hints!

name: DCdle
desc: Guess the character from the DC comics!

name: Deep Cuts
desc: Name the album from its tracklist. Two of an album’s least famous tracks, plus its decade and a genre. Each wrong guess plays a better-known track, building to the biggest hit. Six guesses to name the album.

name: Ensemble
desc: Five faces, name the films two or more of them share. A hit pays by how many faces it covers and how rare the film is, five misses for the day.

name: Episodle
desc: Guess the TV show from a random episode frame. A daily challenge for TV lovers!

name: FilmLink
desc: A trivia game that challenges you to connect two different movies using the actors who appeared in them. The goal is to bridge the gap in as few steps as possible or in the fastest time.

name: HarryPotterDle
desc: Harry Potter guessing game with different modes: Classic, Quote, Description, Spell, Location

name: Headshots
desc: A lineup of actors, naming the most obscure movie you can = the most points

name: Heardle
desc: Guess the song from the intro in as few tries as possible. Every guess will reveal an increasingly longer portion of the song's intro.

name: Hollywoodle
desc: Hollywoodle is a fun and addictive movie guessing game. Guess the movie based on it's blurred poster, release year, and genre.

name: Letter Rip
desc: A few lines of a song, first letters only, in its rhythm. Name it. A new song every day.

name: Letterrankd
desc: Two films appear side by side. One Letterboxd rating is visible and the other is hidden. Guess whether the hidden score is higher or lower to keep your streak alive.

name: Lordle of the Rings
desc: Use only five-letter words (including names) in the main text of Lord of the Rings

name: Lost in Translation
desc: A daily movie game where your clues are a film's real foreign release titles, back-translated into English.

name: Marveldle
desc: Every day, guess a different Marvel character! Attributes revealed with each guess include gender, type, species, powers, origin, and year!

name: Matinee
desc: Six well-known films a day. Type the year each came out, 20 seconds a film, rated out of 10.

name: Movie Poster Quiz
desc: A daily movie guessing game where players try to recognise movies from their posters.

name: Moviedle
desc: A daily movie riddle. Guess the movie based on hints. Gusses reveal reveal Year, World, Genre and Location

name: MovieGrid
desc: How well do you know movies? Movie Grid is a daily trivia game where you use the clues to pick a movie for each spot on the grid. Come back every day for a new puzzle!

name: Musicle
desc: The music-guessing game. Guess the album by hearing a sample of one of its tracks. Simple as that. There are three secret albums to guess each day.

name: Musicle.fun
desc: A daily music artist connection game where you connect two artists through their collaborations in as few steps as possible. A new challenge drops every day. How well do you know the music world?

name: Narutodle
desc: Guess today's character from the manga and anime "Naruto".

name: Netdle Movies
desc: A network visualization based game where you guess a mystery node based on a graph of its connections. In this mode, guess the movie based on connected actors and actresses.

name: Odd Echo
desc: A daily listening game. Five sounds play together: four belong to one place, one doesn't. Solo each sound, find the odd echo, and climb the daily leaderboard.

name: On Location
desc: Like street view but for movies. Look around a 360° filming location and name the movie it appears in, in five guesses.

name: Pitchdle
desc: Pitchdle is a game where a song has been shifted up or down by a random amount, and your job is to tune it back to its original pitch. Slide it up or down, trust your ear, and lock it in when it sounds right.

name: Plot-Hole
desc: Daily movie trivia game. Each day, a new puzzle challenges you to guess a movie from five clues that go from vague to obvious. The earlier you guess correctly, the higher your score.

name: Popdle
desc: Popdle is a daily music puzzle game. An artist is revealed — guess one of their songs using clues about album, year, features, and more. 10 tries.

name: PopIdle
desc: Can you guess the album from the pixelated images of the cover art? Every guess reveals more pixels.

name: Quotesed
desc: A Daily Movie Quote Guessing Game. Can you guess the movie by using 6 quotes?

name: Rushdle
desc:
A daily music guessing game. Each day you get 3 songs played sped up. 
Name the title or artist fast for max points; every wrong guess slows the track down, making it easier to recognise but worth less. Five guesses per song, score is your daily average.

name: Sampledle
desc: A daily music guessing game where you identify famous hits from their original samples.

name: Scenedle
desc: Daily guess-the-video: a muted clip de-blurs with each wrong guess. Five dailies — movies, TV, anime, games, music videos — with clue chips and deduction-friendly suggestions.

name: ScreenIdle
desc: Three daily movie games, one place—guess films from posters, taglines and titles, and come back every day for a new challenge.

name: Screenplaydle
desc: Guess the movie. Then rank the actors by number of lines. 3 new challenges every day, from a variety of movies.

name: Secret sound
desc: Hear a mystery sound clip. use up to 3 hints and 5 guesses to identify the sound. A new sound everyday

name: Showdle
desc: Guess the TV show daily by narrowing down its attributes including year, seasons, genre, format, and network.

name: Six Degrees
desc: Daily movie puzzle: connect two actors through the films they share in six degrees or less. New puzzle every day, free, no login needed.

name: Songdle
desc: Play Songdle - the daily music quiz challenge! Guess the artist, song name, and year from a 30 second clip!

name: Songless
desc: Listen to a song snippet, starting with just 0.1s, then guess the song. Every wrong guess unlocks more of the song. You have 6 tries!

name: SongToSong
desc: A daily music game where you connect two artists via their song collaborations.

name: Spectrle
desc: Spectrle compresses an entire film, 500 frames across the whole runtime, into one radial color spectrum, then gives you five guesses to name it. Each miss sharpens the spectrum and drops a hint.

name: Spotle
desc: Play Spotle, the music daily artist guessing game. Guess the artist in 10 tries! Every guess reveals hints like debut year, gender, genre, and nationality.

name: Spotle Movie
desc: Daily movie guessing game! Guesses reveal hints in the form of year, box office, studio, rating, cast, and more!

name: Star Wordle
desc: Wordle with a Star Wars Twist!

name: Swiftle
desc: Guess the Taylor Swift song from a clip in 6 tries

name: Swordle
desc: Guess the Star Wars themed word each day. Like Wordle, but for Star Wars!

name: Tempo
desc: Same beat for everyone. Rebuild every track as it drops. One attempt. Resets daily.

name: TempoTuner
desc: Try to recall and reproduce the tempo of popular songs, and practice to improve your inner tempo

name: The Sound
desc: Every day there’s a new mystery sound. Play it as often as you like and type what you think it is. You get 10 guesses, and Pop helps when you’re stuck: the category when you’re close, a clean recording after 5 misses, the first letter after 8. The answer drops at midnight.

name: Trackdyl
desc: Name the artist from a blurry album cover. 6 tries daily and the cover reveals bit by bit with each guess.

name: Trick Shot Cinema
desc: Love movies? Prove it. Trick Shot Cinema is a free daily movie-link puzzle: connect 3 films through their cast & crew, from memory.

name: Typecasted
desc: Name any actor who appeared in the starting film, then name another film they appeared in. Chain movies and actors as far as you can!

name: Underscore
desc: Guess the film from a few seconds of its score. The loop starts on one track and you unmute the rest one at a time, five guesses for the day, fewer tracks is a better score.

name: Undersung
desc: Each day, a word is drawn: the goal is to find a song whose lyrics contain it: the less played the song, the more points it earns. Deep cuts beat global hits.

name: vocalstim
desc: Hear a familiar song intro, then it fades out. Hit stop exactly when the vocals should start.

name: Wordzic
desc: Daily music guessing game where a 30-second song clip hides a word to discover. Use Wordle-style clues, unlock hints, and reveal the surprising link between the track and the answer.

name: Allegedly
desc: A daily blind-item guessing game. Each day you read one redacted story about a famous person doing something infamous (or suspiciously wonderful), and you get three strikes to name them.

name: Alpha-Bit
desc: Complete the daily trivia quest while climbing the alphabet as slowly as possible.

name: Am I Dead?
desc: A simple daily game where you are shown a picture of a famous person and have to guess if they are alive or dead. 10 celebrities a day, leaderboards, and streaks.

name: Appdle
desc: Guess the famous app, software or game of the day in 8 tries. Every guess shows 6 clues: type, category, release year, company, platforms and brand colors. Green means exact, yellow means close.

name: At What Point?
desc: A daily game where you predict how the crowd will answer five everyday questions, then compare your own answers with everyone else.

name: AtomixQuest
desc: A Daily chemistry game. Compare real element data from the periodic table — atomic mass, melting point, electronegativity and more. 5 modes, new challenge every day.

name: Babushka
desc: A daily ranking game where every answer must outrank the last. Build the biggest nesting doll you can in under two minutes by naming increasingly higher-ranked items from that day’s mystery list.

name: Bracketdle
desc: In each round, choose the largest of the two opponents! The catch? You don't know what you're ranking until the end! Can you figure out what to choose between China and the USA? is it population or average adult weight? Try it out!

name: Capybaropolis
desc: Animal guessing game. Get 5 clues on what the animal could be as the picture slowly reveals.

name: CarbonixQuest
desc: A carbon footprint puzzle. Across 5 rounds, sort objects and foods by CO2 impact, then estimate ratios like "how many km by car equal 1 kg of beef?". Based on official ADEME data.

name: CardGuessr
desc: Daily guess the card game for Pokemon and Magic the Gathering cards. Each guess reveals more attributes of the card, and unblurs an image.

name: Catfishing
desc: Guess the Wikipedia article from its categories.

name: Centumth
desc: Daily game where you try to find the items ranked closest to 100th place in the category of the day, aiming for the best possible score.

name: CHAINED
desc: Everything is connected. Find the shortest link between seemingly unrelated people, places, movies, brands and more through real-world connections.

name: Cliffle
desc: Seven top-10 lists a day, one guess each. How far in do you dare to go? Given top-10 lists from a wide range of categories, submit an answer as close as possible to the 10th item on that list without going over.

name: CocktailGuessr
desc: Daily cocktail guessing game. A zoomed photo is revealed progressively, with hints for spirit, color, and decade. Name the cocktail. One puzzle per day.

name: Cosmillion
desc: Daily word game where the rarest answer wins. Everyone gets the same 7 prompts a day, like "Name a spice", with 25 seconds each. Common answers score 10, rare ones score 100, and your rocket flies higher.

name: Cutoff
desc:
Name as many answers as you can from three top-100 lists. The deeper the answer, the more it's worth. #1 scores 1 point and #100 scores 100.
Find the hidden #101, the answer just outside the list, for a 500-point jackpot.

name: Daily Herd
desc: Each day, 5 quick questions — guess what most people will answer and try to match the herd. Score, share your 🐑 grid, and keep your daily streak.

name: Daily Orbs
desc: 4 unique trivia puzzles every day. Each has a different topic and answer format. Correct answers fill orbs, and collecting 6 orbs counts as a win for the day.

name: Daily Tens
desc: Daily Tens is a daily trivia game where your goal is to name the top 10 answers for a specific category. Each day presents a single prompt (for example: NFL teams by most Super Bowl wins). Your task is to guess the ten correct items that rank highest for that prompt.

name: Dbdle
desc: Enter the realm of Dead by Daylight and challenge your knowledge of killers and perks in this thrilling mini-game.

name: Decoydle
desc: A daily trivia game where every answer is a number between 0-99. You are given 7 facts and ten numbers, each fact correlates to just one number, meaning there are three decoys. You match a fact to a number one at time until you run out of strikes.

name: Decoydle Themes
desc: Seven clues, ten answers, three decoys, one theme a day.

name: Dobdodle
desc: Guess the famous person based on birth/death places and dates!

name: Duonaut
desc: Two clues, one connection. Name something that fits both, and the rarer your answer, the further your rocket flies.

name: Faceit
desc: Guess the celebrity from a photo that's revealed by clicking on tiles. The less tiles you use, the higher your score.

name: Factle
desc: A trivia game where you must rank a set of answers based on the prompt. After each guess, the color of the tiles will change to show how close your guess was to the real ranking.

name: Fakerz Dozen
desc: A category and thirteen answers. Twelve are real, one is the Faker. Tap the real ones and avoid the fake, because tapping it ends your round.

name: fanimoji
desc: Are you a fan of animals? Prove it. A daily animal is revealed — match the correct emojis to each of its 8 categories. Not sure? You can peek if you need a hint.

name: Floored
desc: Five ranked lists a day, each with a target floor. Name anything on the list and the elevator rides to its rank, showing whether you're too high or too low. Land on the exact floor in as few guesses as you can.

name: Gemdle
desc: A new 5-stone challenge every day. Look at the photo, pick the right crystal, rock or gemstone.

name: GnarlyQ
desc: Each of the five trivia questions shows ten answers: find the five corrects and dodge the traps!

name: Guess the Game
desc: Guess the video game based on screenshots. Each guess reveals a new screeshot. You have 6 tries to guess the game!

name: Higher or Lower
desc: Play the Higher or Lower Game Daily Challenge! 5 categories, 5 rounds, 5 questions each. Score out of 25.

name: How Sure?
desc: Quick fire daily trivia game you can complete in 2 minutes. You hedge your coin balance on one of two answers to a simple question. The coins you win build up and roll over to subsequent days.

name: Hundo
desc: Ten trivia questions a day and a hand of cards, ace to ten. Bet a card on each question: get it right and score it, get it wrong and it burns. Can you hit a hundo?

name: Infoboxing
desc: Guess five Wikipedia articles from their infoboxes every day, one guess each.

name: Kabloom
desc: Seven questions, the catch is you can never use the same answer twice. If you do, Kabloom.

name: Kezaco?
desc: A trivia game where you have 5 clues to try to guess the mystery thing - which can be a person, a place, an event, an animal. The idea behind the game is to win or learn something new.

name: Kytheros
desc: Six number questions a day. Get close without going over and stack the tallest tower.

name: Lineup
desc: Lineup is a daily ranking game where you must arrange 5 items of a specific category in the correct order. For example, land animals (slowest to fastest), country population (smallest to largest), etc.

name: linqed
desc: A daily connection-making trivia game. Four questions, four answers, one hidden link word connecting them all.

name: List Them All!
desc: How many can you list? List Them All is a free daily trivia game where everyone gets the same category and tries to name every item within it. Playful clues and letter reveals help when you get stuck. Each completed puzzle ends with a fun piece of trivia.

name: Long Lost Cousin
desc: One animal and three others: which is its closest relative? Pick one and watch the family tree draw itself.

name: Lostgamer
desc: Get Lost in the Worlds You Love! Get dropped into your favorite game and use your surroundings to guess where you are!

name: Majority
desc: Majority is a daily five-question game about reading the room, not being clever. Given a fresh deck of short, debate-y prompts, type what you think most people will say (the popular answer, not the smartest one).

name: MCdle
desc: Guess a new Minecraft object every day with clues and unlimited attempts! Determine today's mob, block, or item in this Wordle inspired Minecraft riddle game!

name: MetaFour
desc: Decode the clues. Pick the four cards whose answers fit the category. You have four guesses.

name: Minecraft Wordle
desc: A daily Minecraft-themed Wordle game. Guess the hidden Minecraft-related word in six tries and play a new puzzle every day.

name: Moonward
desc: Moonward is a free daily guessing game built on real surveys. Guess the percentages behind six survey questions a day, pick how sure you are, and close guesses fly your rocket toward the Moon.

name: More/Less
desc: Presented with two options, guess which option has more of the category. Categoires are Google Searches, Spotify Streams, and Movie Ratings.

name: OSTdle
desc: Identify songs from video games using short clips!

name: Overunderle
desc: Daily over/under trivia game on real, sourced numbers.

name: OverwatchDLE
desc: OverwatchDLE is a free daily puzzle game for Overwatch fans, with two modes: guess the day's hero from attribute clues, and recognize the map from a close-up image that zooms out with each wrong guess. A new puzzle every day, the same for everyone.

name: Patchdle
desc: Read a real video game's patch notes and guess which game they're from in six tries.

name: Peekpedia
desc: A daily Wikipedia article guessing game. Each day, 5 images from the same article are revealed one at a time. Guess the article in as few images as possible. The earlier you get it, the better your score!

name: Peerkle
desc: Peerkle is a daily ranking puzzle. Eight items and a named axis (sleep hours, release year, population, whatever today's is). Put them in order, low to high. Five tries. After each guess, every item shows whether it's in the right place, one rung off, or further out.

name: Pixeldle
desc: Guess the hidden video game in 10 tries using clues about its year, genre, platform, player count, and developer.

name: Plain
desc: A nice trivia game where every correct answer you fly higher, the exact answer gives you the most points, the closer the answer to the correct the more points you get.

name: Plinkle Trivia
desc: A daily trivia game on a peg board. Drop a ball five times, and wherever it lands, answer that category's next question. Every question pays more than the last, and three wildcard cups pay a bonus.

name: Pokedle
desc: Pokedle is a visual Pokemon guessing game inspired by wordle.

name: Pokelingo
desc: Pokelingo is a daily Pokémon riddle. Read the Pokédex entry, guess the Pokémon. Get hints based on Pokemon attruibutes.

name: PokéKrillion
desc: A daily Pokémon trivia dive. Obvious answers float. Rare answers sink you into the deep.

name: Questle
desc: A videogame guessing game! Guess a game to reveal attributes like release year, rating, publisher, genre, and many more!

name: Quiple
desc: Daily trivia game in a pseudo-connections style format. Connect tiles on the board based on the daily category.

name: QuizHustle
desc: 90+ bite-sized trivia challenges spanning pop culture, music, geography, gaming, and sports. Correct answers earn points, speed multiplies score, live global leaderboard.

name: Quizl
desc: Quizl is a daily trivia game inspired by Wordle. Think you can be the trivia master? Test your trivia skills every day!

name: R6DLE
desc: Daily puzzle game for Rainbow Six Siege fans, with four modes: guess the day's operator from attribute clues, from a blurred full-body render, or from their unique gadget's icon — and recognize the R6 map from a zoomed image.

name: Rewind
desc: Ten trivia questions a day from twenty-six subjects, or mix them all.

name: Riddling
desc: riddling is a daily guessing game for all ages, like “twenty questions” with out-of-the-box clues. Can you guess the answer to today's riddle in five clues?

name: Rivaldle
desc: Rivaldle is an interactive, Wordle-style trivia game based on the video game Marvel Rivals

name: Roomio
desc: Three yes/no questions a day from real public surveys. Answer, then guess what % of people said yes.

name: Rough Draft
desc: Five things. How do they stack up? An approachable daily ordering game from Hindsight Games.

name: Science Gauntlet
desc: Five daily science quizzes played back to back as one run: the human body, life science, physics and space, inventions and chemistry. Ten questions each, twenty seconds a question, one life in each.

name: Seldom
desc: Seldom is a free daily trivia game with a twist: rare beats obvious, so you're trying to come up with the answer almost nobody else would think of. You get 5 guesses, lower scores win, and a new puzzle drops every day at midnight UTC.

name: Sharkdle
desc: A daily shark-species guessing game. Identify sharks using clues, taxonomy, habitat, and biological characteristics while learning about marine life.

name: Shelf Life
desc: Five real product photos a day, guess the year each one hit shelves, then share your spoiler-free receipt. Same five for everyone.

name: Sortem
desc: Each day you get a themed set of items — countries, cities, foods, books, whatever — and a metric to rank them by, like population, year, or size. Drag them into the correct order, get color-coded feedback on how close you were, and share your result.

name: SPAN
desc: Daily trivia game played on a board of hexagons. Pick a hex on the left, read the clue, and type the answer. Right answers turn gold and link up, and a wrong one blocks that hex. Build a gold path to the other side of the board before the 100-second clock runs out.

name: Spawnle
desc: Video game guessing game where you have ten attempts to identify a mystery title. Each guess reveals how details like release year, developer, genre, and platforms compare with the answer, helping you narrow it down.

name: Squridle
desc: I'm thinking of a Pokémon. Can you guess which!? Guesses reveal Pokemon attributes!

name: Stardewdle
desc: A Wordle-inspired game for Stardew Valley fans. Guess the daily crop and test your farming knowledge!

name: Steamdle
desc: Identify one Steam game each day from six real player-review clues. Guess after each reveal, then share your score.

name: Stranded
desc: Answer six questions, earn points for rare responses, help your alien escape, and discover nine different endings.

name: Swivia
desc: Swivia is a fast trivia game - swipe right for yes, left for no, up to skip. Race the clock, build streaks, beat your high score.

name: Tall Ordle
desc: Guess the order of the tallest buildings, fastest cars, oldest people, etc. to stack these blocks to the sky - or the stars!! Its a TALL ORDLE, but you can do it!

name: Terradle
desc: A Wordle-like guessing game inspired by the game Terraria.

name: The Club
desc: Some are in the club, some are not. Work out the secret rule and judge five more at the door. A new club every day.

name: The Daily Investor
desc: A free daily investing puzzle where players guess the mystery public company using clues about its business, financials, industry, and market history. One new puzzle every day.

name: Top Answer Club
desc: A Family Feud style daily survey quiz. Guess the most popular answers and share your score with friends!

name: Translate or Die
desc: Pick the correct translation in 5 seconds, or lose a life. A fast, addictive translation game. Choose from 9 languages or play them all at once!

name: Trivia Gauntlet
desc: Seven daily quizzes back to back as one long run: a topic in depth, world geography, sports, business, quotes, film scripts, and forty questions of anything. Twenty seconds a question and one life per quiz.

name: TruthSweeper
desc: Minesweeper made of facts. Each card is a statement; call it True or False. Tap the true ones to reveal how many false cards touch them, and use the numbers to find the lies. Three wrong answers and the case goes unsolved.

name: Ultimate Drive IQ
desc: Daily general trivia game with a football twist. Everyone gets the same final drive each day: answer four trivia questions on all kinds of topics (not just football) to move the ball and score the winning touchdown.

name: Uncommet
desc: Eight daily prompts, one journey. Any real answer counts, and rare ones push your rocket to the Moon, Mars and Pluto. One mission a day.

name: Uncommon Trivia
desc: Type one answer per prompt within 25 seconds. Any correct answer counts, but rarer answers score more, based on how often each answer's Wikipedia page is read.

name: Wardle
desc: Guess the tanks, planes and ships based on their parameters from game war thunder.

name: What?
desc: Given two things, guess which one was bigger yesterday. All sourced from real pageview data.

name: Who?
desc: Guess what the crowd actually answered, from published surveys. Five rounds a day; the reveal shows the crowd's answer beside your guess.

name: Whydle
desc: A daily puzzle where five things are already in order. Your job is to figure out why. Each puzzle draws from general knowledge, including geography, history, entertainment, food, sports, science, and more.

name: Wing It
desc: The daily quiz show where nobody knows the topic. Answer like an expert, then name it.

name: Wonderhop
desc: Climb with the answer everyone gives, or dive with the one nobody gives.

name: 100 of Us
desc: Of 100 people in the world, how many…? Press and hold to guess, then see the real number with its source.

name: 2 Minute Drill
desc: Call the plays in real NFL endings. One drive a day: beat the real coach and see how you rank.
Pick your side in the player duel, build your team, then simulate a full season chasing the perfect unbeaten campaign.
Build the ultimate NBA all-time team and see if you can go 82-0!

name: Acrobeat
desc: A play-by-ear timing game with a fresh daily challenge. Each day is one 10-step puzzle, and everyone gets the same gaps. Listen to the interval between two beeps, then reproduce it from memory to climb.

name: Alibi
desc: A daily cozy-mystery logic puzzle. A death overnight, a household full of statements — place every suspect and piece of evidence back where they belong, and the room with the killer marks itself.

name: alikely
desc: Find all the emojis that share a single connection. Difficulty increases throughout the week.

name: Amountle
desc: The daily estimation game. Watch objects drop and guess the count — five rounds, eight seconds each.

name: Angledle
desc: Angledle is an geometric angle guessing game. Challenge yourself with the daily puzzle or play in unlimited mode.

name: Angler
desc: A daily geometry puzzle: guess a shown angle's exact measure in degrees in four tries, guided by higher/lower hints and a hot-cold closeness tier.

name: Anthropeum
desc: Each day you get a 10 artifacts from the Met's open-access collection and guess where and when each was made.

name: Anything Categories
desc: Anything Grid, in reverse! Unscramble the grid so each answer is in its correct row and column, then name the mystery categories to complete the puzzle!

name: Anything Grid
desc: Fill each cell with anything that matches both categories on the grid.

name: Appraisle
desc: Two puzzles a day about what houses are worth. Put a price on three homes that really sold, then design one to fit a budget.

name: Asteroidle
desc: Study an asteroid's movement for one second, predict its path, take aim, and fire.

name: Athletele
desc: Guess the athlete from their season-by-season stat line. NBA, NFL, MLB, and NHL modes.

name: Auctimate
desc: Using pictures and discriptions, guess the auction price that items were sold for.

name: Ball Don't Cry
desc: NBA stats-based trivia game. Try to guess the player based on their career statistics.

name: Ballpark
desc: Ballpark, a daily guessing game where you don't need the exact number, just the right ballpark. Five "how many…?" questions a day, from easy to absurd, all answered in powers of ten.

name: Bartition
desc: Guess how real data is split on a bar chart, then see how close your guess was!

name: Batter Up!
desc: Can you guess the player based on their silhouette? Includes baseball (MLB), football (NFL), and basketball (NBA) modes!

name: BBall Tradle
desc: Tradle gives you an NBA trade to identify by year and by the two teams involved. Each wrong guess reveals more of the trade package, so the puzzle gets easier as you go. It is part trivia, and part proving you know ball.

name: Beat the Couch
desc: $10,000 to start. Two secret years of real market history. One button: BUY or SELL. Your opponent is a "couch" in the S&P 500, they always hold. Can you beat the couch?

name: Bevel
desc: Bevel is a daily literary deduction game. Read a short passage from a public-domain work and try to deduce the author, decade, nationality, and title from the prose itself.

name: Birdle
desc: Six guesses to identify the bird of the day. Wordle-style hints based on scientific taxonomy

name: Bonkle
desc: Bonkle gives you a board of numbered blocks and a monster with a silly name sitting in the middle of it. Drag to aim, let go, and watch a volley of balls rattle around the board. You get five volleys to clear the lot. Can you bonk it before it gets away?

name: BookCoverDle
desc: Guess the famous children's book by an obfuscated view of its cover within 6 guesses.

name: Brandle
desc: Identify today's brand from a blurred logo in 8 tries. Hints reveal industry, country and age.

name: CapItUp
desc: A daily market cap guessing game, like Wordle for finance. Five quick rounds on S&P 500 companies: drag a square to size one company against another, rank four companies by staff, profit, stores or revenue, then estimate one number.

name: Career Path
desc: Guess the mystery legendary footballer as their clubs are revealed one by one. You see their first club right away; every wrong guess reveals the next. Your guess count equals however many clubs they played for.

name: Cars
desc: Five cars. Twenty seconds each. Guess the sale price and see how close you get.

name: Cars and Games
desc: A daily series of car guessing games. Wide variety of games included in the daily mix, including guessing from the blurred image, or predicting the sell price of car auctions.

name: CFBordle
desc: A daily College Football word puzzle. Similar to Wordle, but College Football themed!

name: Chartdle
desc: Chartdle is a daily Wordle-style guessing game that challenges traders and investors to identify stocks, forex, or crypto symbols based solely on price action charts.

name: Chroma
desc: A daily color-mixing puzzle: match the target color in six guesses by mixing three shades from a palette, with feedback graded on real color math.

name: ChronoTrivia
desc: Order events in the correct chronological order to win! Choose from categories like entertainment, tech, sports, science, and history!

name: Clutch Six
desc: Daily NBA and NFL puzzle game. You're given six categories and have to find three athletes who cover all six with no overlap. Each athlete can match multiple categories, so finding the right combination to the puzzle is the challenge.

name: Color
desc: Humans can't reliably recall colors. This is a simple game to see how good (or bad) you are at it. You are given 5 colors, and must recreate them from memory.

name: Color Context
desc: Two circles, two backgrounds, one color. Slide until they look the same, then watch the backgrounds slide away and compare them side by side on white.

name: Color Toon
desc: Five pop-culture icons. You select the correct colors. One shot. No pressure.

name: Colorfle
desc: A game where you mix colors to find the color of the day, Wordle-style

name: ColorGuessr
desc: Guess the day's 5 interestingly named colors using a color wheel. One try. The closer you are to the actual color, the higher your score.

name: Comparle
desc: One foreign word a day, four rounds to work it out. Instead of picking an answer you place a dot on a radar between four options, then stake your score on typing the translation.

name: Compoundle
desc: Get real stock ticker data at a specific moment in history, with financial clues from that date. Make your move by choosing to Invest, Short, or Pass based on how you think the stock will perform, then see how you did!

name: Courtdle
desc: Read the facts of three criminal cases and pick the right charge: murder or manslaughter, robbery or burglary? Charge too high and Lex Loophole objects; get it right and the gavel comes down.

name: Crackerjack
desc: Crackerjack is a daily challenge to solve four slightly cryptic puzzles to open the safe.

name: Cricle
desc: A cricket player guessing game based on attributes and silhouette of the player. Guess the mystery player to score runs and win before the super over ends!

name: Crossbar
desc: Seven new football-related questions every day. You get 25 seconds and one answer for each. The rarer it is, the further back the ball goes. At full time you shoot from wherever you ended up. Go the distance.

name: Daily Audit
desc: A 60-second daily audit: 12 quick items (mental arithmetic, patterns, working memory, sequences) against one clock - same audit for everyone each day.

name: Daily Detective
desc: Daily Detective gives you a new murder mystery every day. You have 10 moves to ask suspects questions, examine evidence for clues about the killer, weapon, and motive before you make your accusation.

name: Daily Draft
desc: Draft the best roster in history! A daily fantasy football draft game spanning NFL seasons from 1970 to today.

name: Daily Grapple
desc: A daily grappling hook speedrun platformer.  Everyone gets the same new course each day and there's a global leaderboard.

name: Daily Jig
desc: A simple and quick daily jigsaw puzzle game you can play in a few minutes. Designed to be relaxing, easy to pick up, and something you'll want to come back to every day.

name: Daily Lowball
desc: 5 real cars everyday. Try to guess the price. Then find out what they actually sold for.

name: Daily Murder
desc: Daily murder mystery logic puzzle. New whodunit every morning. Gather clues, examine evidence, and solve the murder mystery!

name: Daily Putt
desc: An arcade style daily mini putt round with 3 new courses each day!

name: Daily Skill Gauntlet
desc: The Daily Skill Gauntlet is one quick run through eight different tests, back to back, including reaction speed, memory, time estimation, and mental math.

name: Daily Sleuth
desc: A daily puzzle game where you solve a new mystery every day set in the fictional city of Caldmere. With 40+ characters across 13 locations and more added weekly.

name: Daily Time Travel
desc: A daily history game: hop from one historical event to another by picking which happened more recently. Reach the goal year in as few hops as you can — par is 3. A new journey every day.

name: Daily Timeline
desc: A daily history puzzle. Travel from one historical event to another in 5 steps - at each step, pick which of two events comes next in time. One mistake ends the run, but every event teaches you a short fact.

name: Decade
desc: Five historic photos a day. Guess the year each was taken; closer guesses score more, out of 5,000.

name: Deep Cut
desc: Deep Cut is a daily hockey trivia game. Everyone gets the same six prompts, and each one has many right answers. You are scored on how rare your right answer is: the name most fans would never reach for is worth the most.

name: DeepBall
desc: A daily NFL "deep cut" trivia game. 7 "name a player" questions where the deeper your cut, the more points your score. E.g. Name a Patriots QB: Tom Brady = 10 yards, Ryan Mallett = 85

name: Deuce Day
desc: A daily tennis quiz played out on a pixel court

name: Distancity
desc: Look around real 360° street photos from places worldwide and guess how far away the pinned building, sign or pole is.

name: Doctordle
desc: A diagnosis guessing game. Test your medical knowledge with daily clinical scenarios.

name: Dribble
desc: Connect NBA Players through mutual teammates. A challenging game for fans who follow the league closely.

name: Dropped
desc: A ball is thrown, watch the start of an arc, then call where the ball lands before it gets there!

name: DSMdle
desc: Guess the DSM-5 medical diagnosis using 6 clues.

name: Earlier
desc: A daily 3-question quiz: “Which happened earlier?” Sounds easy, until it isn't. Challenge your timeline instincts and come back each day for a new set. Share and compete with friends.

name: Echoes
desc: A daily history game: five fictional eyewitnesses describe one moment in history, one voice at a time – pin where and when it happened on a globe and a timeline. Fewer voices, more points.

name: Elimina8
desc: Eliminate all but the earliest historical event from the given 8. The last elimination is the hardest.

name: Eraly
desc: Seven moments from history a day, same for everyone. Guess the year. The closer you get, the further you travel.

name: EraPin
desc: See a real historical photograph. Drop a pin on where it happened. Scroll to the year. EraPin is a free daily history and geography game — 5 rounds, up to 25,000 points. New event every day, plus an archive of previous days.

name: Estimania
desc: A fun, 2-minute daily estimation game. Guess the numbers behind five interesting real-world facts and see how good your intuition really is over your morning coffee.

name: Estimatle
desc: Make five estimates each day, ranging from years and distances to quantities and more. Get as close as you can, compare your guesses with other players, and discover surprising facts along the way.

name: Every Beat
desc: One real animal: drag to set how fast you think its heart beats, then see the real heart beat beside yours.

name: Extraplot
desc: Extrapolate historic graphs as accurately as possible over multiple categories

name: Factual
desc: Each day you get six scatter charts of real data, see where four things land, and place the fifth.

name: Far-Fetched
desc: 7 offbeat news stories, 5 true, 2 false. Map the true ones. Every point drops his jaw deeper.

name: Fermi
desc: A daily estimation puzzle game. You get three questions and one guess each, to land as close to the real answer as possible. You're scored on how close you get, as a multiple.

name: Fermi Questions
desc: Big questions, no calculator: how many heartbeats in a day? Estimate, see how many times off you were, then follow the worked answer. Five a day.

name: Find The Needle
desc: Find the needle in a haystack!

name: Flag Fill
desc: One section of a flag is missing, try to guess its exact color.

name: Flipsies
desc: Flip five everyday objects and land each upright. Three throws per object in a new daily challenge that takes about four minutes.

name: Football Bingo
desc: Players arrive one at a time and you slot each into one of 12 categories: club, nationality, league or award. The right slot locks the box, a wrong one shakes it but you can keep going.

name: Football Connections
desc: Sort 16 footballers into 4 hidden groups of 4. Each group shares something - same team, same nation, same position or same age. You get 4 mistakes. A new grid every day.

name: Football Drop
desc: A daily guessing football game. Find the stadium where this iconic moment happened!

name: Football Grid
desc: The daily football club crossover puzzle. Fill the 3x3 grid by naming a footballer who played for both intersecting clubs. 9 guesses, a new grid every day!

name: Football Logo Quiz
desc: Name the club by looking at its crest through a small peephole that widens with each wrong answer.

name: Football Wordle
desc: Wordle for footballers: crack the name the player goes by. The word length changes every day and each guess colors in like classic Wordle.

name: FootyIQ · Forgotten Footballer
desc: Guess the mystery footballer from a blurred photo and a few clues. A new player every day, solve it in fewer guesses and faster to boost your Footy IQ.

name: From the Logo
desc: Daily NBA trivia game built around deep cuts: one new puzzle a day that rewards real hoops knowledge over the obvious names

name: Fumbll
desc: Fumbll is a daily fantasy football guessing game: 6 guesses to name the mystery NFL player, with clue-based feedback on team, position, age, fantasy points, and more.

name: GeoPaint
desc: Recreate a country flag's missing colour with hue, saturation and brightness sliders.

name: Geosportle
desc: The daily where + when sports quiz. Five famous sports moments a day: pin where each happened on a 3D globe and guess the year. Football, cricket, F1, tennis, rugby, golf and more.

name: GoatLab
desc: Spin the reel, draft real pros into the attribute slots, then simulate their entire career.

name: Gradientle
desc: Gradientle - the daily color puzzle: align colored tiles, so that a perfect 2D gradient is created!

name: Griductive
desc: Griductive is a daily deductive logic puzzle game. Play as a detective and classify each character on the grid as Suspect or Innocent — using only logical clues.

name: GroundIQ
desc: A daily stadium-guessing challenge. You're dropped into a locked panoramic view of a ground and have to name the home club before time expires. Faster answers keep more points.

name: Guess The Menu
desc: Discover new restaurants by guessing what's on their menu. Beat the daily challenge and try local mode to unlock spots near you—and maybe your next meal.

name: Guess The NBA Player
desc: The NBA player guessing game. Try to guess the mystery player in 10 tries using hints. A new mystery player every day at midnight EST!

name: Guess the Weight
desc: How many grapes weigh as much as a football? Set the count, then watch the balance scale tip. Five estimation rounds a day, with real weights from official sources.

name: Guessmint
desc: Guessmint is a free daily history guessing game where players identify a real antique coin by determining which country, state or tribe issued it and approximately in what era it was struck. A world history game, one coin a day.

name: Headlines
desc: Guess the year five real newspaper headlines were published. New puzzle daily, same headlines for every player, shareable results.

name: Hearsay
desc: Work out who’s telling the truth and who’s lying from their clues and one daily rule.

name: Hertl
desc: NHL Player Guessing Game. Every guess will reveal info like team, conference, division, position, age, nation, and jersey number.

name: Hexle
desc: Guess the colour of #Hexle in 6 tries! How well do you know your hex colors? After each guess, see how close your color is to the target.

name: HistoriaQuest
desc: Daily guessing game with three challenges on history's greatest figures, inventions, and events. New challenges every day.

name: Historic Firsts
desc: Place famous “firsts” in chronological order, from groundbreaking inventions to major discoveries and historical milestones. A new history ranking challenge every day.

name: HistoryGuesso
desc: Uncover the event using as few clues as possible, testing your knowledge of history in a concise daily format. The game is presented as a daily history quiz, with one new event available each day.

name: Housle
desc: A real estate guessing game. Guess the list price of houses! Each guess reveals a new photo from the listing.

name: How big?
desc: Drag the shape to guess the size of a real thing, against a reference that never changes.

name: How expensive?
desc: One item, one place, one date: set the price it cost, then see the real price from official price statistics.

name: How likely?
desc: Guess how likely something is to happen (like hitting a royal flush), from 1 in 1 to 1 in a billion, then see how close other players got.

name: How many?
desc: Drag up or down to guess how many people fit in a real place.

name: How sweet?
desc: Pull a slider up to guess the amount of sugar in a real product.

name: HowMuch.gg
desc: Guess how much wacky things cost, from weird auction items to cars to companies!

name: Hue Duel
desc: Try to guess the theme of the color palette. Each wrong guess reveals a hint, or if you are confident, play on artist mode, where each failed guess does not earn a clue.

name: Huedle
desc: Color gradient puzzle game - with a fresh board every day. Rearrange the tiles to form a perfect gradient across the grid. Your goal is to complete the grid in the least moves and fastest time. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

name: Hueman
desc: How sharp are your eyes? In this game, you must identify the colored tile on the grid which has a slightly different hue than the others. Each round gets more difficult.

name: Hues
desc: Match a target color by feel before the clock runs out. One Daily Hue puzzle a day with a shareable score grid, plus easy and practice modes.

name: illivia
desc: A daily trivia game where every answer is a number. Six guesses, with hot-and-cold feedback on each.

name: Immaculate Grid
desc: Put your football knowledge to the test! Immaculate Grid is a daily trivia game powered by Sports Reference. Come back for a new NFL grid challenge every day!

name: Its Price
desc: Guess the price of all sorts of items with higher and lower hints. Household items, luxury fashion, homes, and art.

name: Jaardle
desc: Guess the year of the event. After each guess, get feedback based on how far you are from the actual year. Hints available if you get stuck

name: Journeys
desc: Guess the football (soccer) player based on their jersey, club history, debut, teammate, and nationality. A new player each day.

name: Kickoff Trivia
desc: Dily football true/false quiz. Each day one category is marked “Today's challenge” (players, clubs, nations, global championships, transfers, etc.). Play 10 cards with a 12-second timer per question; swipe right for True, left for False (or tap ✓/✕).

name: Kinda Hard Golf
desc: A daily mini golf challenge. Navigate tricky obstacles and sink the ball with as few shots as you can!

name: Knot Really
desc: One tangled question a day. Underneath it is a plain number question like "How far is the Moon?", but it's wrapped in double negatives and other twisty wording.

name: Language Tree
desc: Guess languages based on their language family

name: Late Innings
desc: Manage real MLB postseason games from every October since 1970. Pick either dugout, get every call graded, and see how other players called it.

name: Legacy Run - Daily
desc: Solve the daily minigame to unlock the featured star, then spin four teammates from pro basketball history under a salary cap, play out an 82-game season and climb the daily leaderboard.

name: Liftdle
desc: Wordle for fitness lovers! Guess the exercise, and get hints based attributes like muscle group, equipment, movement pattern, and more.

name: Liftle
desc: Guess the gym exercise from heat map of activated muscles and equipment.

name: LinguaBoard
desc: A daily language grid puzzle. Find the language which matches the facts on the sides of the grid.

name: LinkyGrid World Cup
desc: Find the links between players that have played with or against each other in at least one World Cup Match.

name: Listed
desc: Real estate price guessing game. Guess the sale price of a recently sold property!

name: Logohue
desc: Use a color palette to guess the brand color of the logo shown in grayscale. One guess per day.

name: Machine
desc: A daily contraption puzzle. The machine is almost built: drag the last parts into place, press Run and watch the chain reaction.

name: Magnitudle
desc: Test your estimation skills with a new mind-bending question every day. How close can you get?

name: Marginle
desc: Across 3 statewide races, use the information given to peg down what year the election was held.

name: Marked
desc: A spatial memory game. Marks appear one by one on an empty board, then vanish: tap where they were.

name: Meanwhile
desc: A daily history guessing game: could Mozart have seen a hot air balloon? Twelve cards a day, each answer proved on a timeline drawn to scale.

name: Metaflora
desc: The family tree of the plant kingdom (which scientists call Viridiplantae) is broad and beautiful... but also complex! Metaflora is a game that tests your green thumb by seeing how well you can navigate its leafy branches.

name: Metazooa
desc: Metazooa is a game that tests how well you know our extended family tree. Your goal is to figure out today's Animal in as few guesses as possible. Wrong guesses will narrow down the answer by taxonomic rank (kingdom, phylum, class, order, etc.)

name: Mise
desc: Guess the dish from its ingredients. Six clues reveal one at a time, hardest first, and every miss adds a clue.

name: Missing 11
desc: A legendary historical starting 11 is presented with 3 players hidden. Can you complete the iconic lineup based on the team's formation and year?

name: Mixed
desc: A color mixing game. See a color, pick the paints that made it in equal parts, and stir. Three colors a day.

name: MLB Name Chain
desc: MLB player name chain game. Users need to connect a starting player, middle player, and end player using active and former all-star MLB players. The chain is formed from the first letter of the starting player's last name. The next player's 1st name needs to start with that same letter. Ex. Pete Alonso --> Aaron Judge.

name: Mochi's Blind Maze
desc: A new foggy maze every day, same one for everyone. Guide Mochi through the fog, dodge ghosts, outrun the Hunter and beat the clock.

name: Morning Mystery
desc: Every morning, a new little mystery shakes out over breakfast at the caravan. Read the clues, catch the lies, and work the grid to win!

name: Name the Painting
desc: A daily art puzzle: name the painting in six guesses. Each one tells you how close you are.

name: NFL Wordle
desc: Play NFL Wordle, the daily player guessing game! Inspired by Wordle and Weddle, can you guess the NFL player from the clues? A new challenge is released every day!

name: Nurdle
desc: A cricket-themed Wordle. Each guess reveals attributes about the cricket player.

name: Nutrition Factdle
desc: Guess the price and fill in the blank nutrition facts information of a random food item!

name: One More Torch
desc: Twelve rooms. Nine torches. One daily dungeon. Grab treasure, dodge traps, and decide when to walk away. How far will you push your luck?

name: One Stroke
desc: Draw one line and drop the marble into the cup.

name: Out of 24
desc: An animal or a country’s people: how many hours a day do they sleep, eat or work?

name: Overbid
desc: Bid upward on a real-world number you can't look up. A bid that stays under tells you only "still under". Go over and the round is worth nothing.

name: Paintiquity
desc: Guess the year of creation of a gallery of paintings!

name: Palette
desc: Daily color mixing puzzle. Match a target color by adjusting RGB and CMY sliders — scored by perceptual color distance.

name: Pantheon
desc: Daily football game: two players, one season, one figure. The first one's is given: does the second have more or fewer? Goals, assists, matches, yellow cards. Ten duels, one mistake and it's over.

name: PatentGuessr
desc: Guess the invention from a real patent drawing. One mystery patent a day from the US archives, six guesses, with clues straight from the file, filing date, scale, class, and the redacted claim.

name: Pattern
desc: Humans are wired to spot broken patterns. Let's see how fast you can fix one.

name: PicBits
desc: A daily picture puzzle. Reveal cells, recognize the image, and protect your score.

name: Pickle
desc: MLB Player Guessing Game. Guesses reveal player information like team, division, batting stance, position, and age.

name: Picxle
desc: A daily game where you guess the pixelated image, every wrong guess brings it more into focus.

name: Player of the Day
desc: A daily football (soccer) guessing game. Use logical clues like team, nation, position, age, and shirt number to find the mystery player of the day in 8 guesses. No sign-up required.

name: Plumb
desc: A daily test of physical intuition. Water in a tilted glass, a wheel slowing down, a hidden lamp, how long things last and a vanishing pool shot.

name: Poeltl
desc: NBA Player Guessing Game. Guess the player based on current team, position, and measurables. Do you know ball?

name: POUR
desc: POUR is a daily 3D game with an eye test. One glass is tipped into another, and you guess where the liquid will land. There are five pours a day.

name: Poured
desc: A volume estimation game. A drink in one glass is poured into another: mark where it will reach. Three pours a day.

name: Price Check
desc: Five real items a day with real prices as of a stated date: an Amazon find, a new car, a home for sale, a flight or hotel stay, and a luxury piece. Five guesses at each with a hint after every guess, one score out of 50, and a daily leaderboard.

name: PricedIn
desc: PricedIn is a daily price-guessing game that tests your knowledge of what things actually cost in 6 different years. From fast food to modern fashion, you have three tries to nail the price for each year. It's "The Price is Right" meets Wordle - can you get it right?

name: PriceTag
desc: Step onto the market desk and value five transfers. Read each deal, set your fee, and try to beat the market. The closer your guess to the real fee, the more points you bank.

name: Pricier
desc: Higher or lower with launch prices in today's money: did a 1977 Atari 2600 cost more than a PS5? A daily chain of ten calls, plus an endless streak mode.

name: Propagandle
desc: A daily game where you classify conspiracies as real or not. Test your historical knowledge and see how much you actually know.

name: Puckdoku
desc: Guess the NHL players that fit into the different categories provided on the grid.

name: Pwnedle
desc: How many times has “password123” been leaked? Each day you get five real passwords and guess how often each one turned up in data breaches. The closer you get, the more you score.

name: Read the Tape
desc: Five real S&P 500 charts a day with tickers and dates hidden. Call up or down over the next five trading days and see what actually happened.

name: Reciple
desc: Reciple gives you a recipe card with the dish's name torn off. Carbonara or cacio e pepe? Pho or ramen? Read the ingredients, make a guess, and watch the ones you got right light up.

name: Recko
desc: A daily estimation puzzle, mixing educated guesswork with a bit of timed mental arithmetic

name: Redacted
desc: A daily word puzzle game set in the fictional city of Caldmere. Each day, you're handed a redacted police file document, key words have been blacked out, and it's your job to figure out what's hidden beneath.

name: Regex Hunter
desc: A daily regex puzzle: write one pattern that catches every target word and spares every decoy, in as few characters as you can.

name: Revealo
desc: Guess the photo from a tiny close-up, every wrong guess zooms out a bit more. 5 images per day, 4 tries per image, get the highest score with a maximum of 500 points.

name: Roam
desc: Seven numbers to estimate each day, one guess each. The closer your measure, the further your knight travels.

name: Roguedle
desc: Defeat 8 monsters by choosing the optimal 7+ items each day! Will you choose holy burn? High crit glass canon? An unkillable vampire tank? Choose everyday on Roguedle!

name: Roster Relay
desc: Connect two athletes by building a chain using other players they shared a team with. Try creating shorter and/or rarer routes than the competition! NBA, NFL, and MLB modes!

name: Rotaboxes
desc: Relaxing photo puzzle game. Rotate the pieces to unscramble the photo.

name: Saloondle
desc: Western history trivia game with a roguelike twist. Each day brings one category and five clues, four choices each, with payouts rising as the clues get harder. Spend your winnings on items in the shop.

name: Same Energy
desc: One real food or drink a day. Fill a plate or pour glasses of another until it holds the same energy, then see the real amount, from two official food tables.

name: Scale It
desc: A size guessing game: stretch an object to its real size next to one you know, from coins to the Eiffel Tower. Five pairs a day, plus unlimited play.

name: Scentle
desc: The daily puzzle for fragrance lovers. Up to six guesses to name today's fragrance from its notes and infos.

name: Scout
desc: SCOUT is a daily hockey guessing game. One NHL player is picked each morning, the same one for everybody, and you have eight guesses to work out who he is.

name: scrandle
desc: Daily list of stadium food from around the world, guess what the majority of other guessers would rather eat.

name: Shamshot
desc: 3 new unbelievable images or videos drop every day, and you vote on whether each is a "Snapshot" (real) or a "Shamshot" (AI/Edited).

name: Shellenium
desc: Guess the day’s event in history from its clues. Every guess flings a hermit crab across the ages, and he points the way: earlier or later.

name: SHIFT
desc: Shift — a daily sliding puzzle where everyone solves the same puzzle and races the clock to see who's fastest.

name: SIXTY
desc: Five quick micro-games back to back: pick the bigger expression, spot the odd one out, and guess which happened first. A fast paced game - try to complete all of them in under 60 seconds!

name: Size It Up
desc: Size It Up is a daily visual estimation game where you resize one object to match its real-world scale against another. Test your sense of size with everything from animals and landmarks to everyday objects, then see how close you got.

name: SLYDE
desc: 3x3 sliding puzzle built from a new photo each day. Solve it in as few moves as possible and see how you stack up against the optimal solution (and your friends).

name: Somebodle
desc: Guess the famous figure from five clues.

name: SoReal
desc: SoReal is a daily challenge: two images appear side by side, and you get one chance daily to determine which one you think is AI generated.

name: Spectra
desc: Crack the hidden RGB color in 6 guesses using hot/cold feedback per channel.

name: Sportdle
desc: Daily player guessing game! Premier League, Euroleague, NBA, NHL, NFL, and Formula 1 options!

name: Sportiz
desc: Daily player guessing game! Soccer (football), Golf, Cricket, Formula 1 & Tennis options!

name: Sports Connections
desc: Sports Connections is a sports themed puzzle game where you must group words in the grid by a common attribute.

name: Squigdle
desc: A daily game where you turn random Squiggles into Doodles, then vote on your favorites!

name: Starting 5 Trivia
desc: Daily NBA trivia. 5 players, 12 questions, 10-second shot clock, about a minute.

name: Statle
desc: NBA Stats guessing game built from real all-time career numbers. Three game modes, Over/Under, Career Clash, and Hit the Target.

name: Sundaydle
desc: Guess the daily mystery NFL player, keep your streak, and share your result — a free daily NFL trivia game.

name: Suspectle
desc: Place every suspect on a floor plan, one per row and one per column. Whoever is left alone with the victim did it. No guessing necessary — every case has exactly one solution reachable by pure deduction.

name: Swervle
desc: Race today's swervle. 3D car racing game, where everyone gets the same map every day.

name: Tastedle
desc: A daily food guessing game: guess a dish's country of origin from clues about its ingredients and cooking. Includes a food Connections mode and a Higher or Lower mode.

name: Temvo
desc: A time-perception game. Guess how long a hidden timer ran, stop it dead on target, echo an interval, hold a beat after it goes silent. Five new rounds every day with practice mode.

name: That THAT Game
desc: A daily word game that rewards creativity. Each day brings five pairs like "Things in a purse *THAT* will confuse the aliens": name something that fits both, say why, and the more clever the idea the higher it scores.

name: The Ball Grid
desc: Daily Premier League football trivia game that tests real player statistics rather than club affiliations. Each day, complete a 3×3 grid by naming footballers who satisfy intersecting statistical criteria such as goals scored, clean sheets, appearances, minutes played, or seasons at a club. Answers are scored by rarity.

name: The Chains
desc: Daily NFL-player puzzle where you connect a Start player to a Finish player through a chain of shared teams and colleges.

name: The Daily Hue
desc: A daily color-matching game built around famous paintings. Each day features a different artwork. Guess the featured color using HSL sliders in 5 tries.

name: The Heatmap
desc: Name the footballer from where he touched the ball. Six guesses, and a clue after every miss.

name: The Loop
desc: Everything is connected: Arrange the pictures in a circle so that all links make sense. You have five tries to get it right.

name: THE SPLIT
desc: Each day, guess how the world responds to one controversial question. Cast your vote, then predict what percent of the world agrees with you.

name: Thingdle
desc: Guess the every-day object with a riddle to start with. You get 2 more hints along the way. Each guess reveals a wordle-like grid of object attributes. You have 6 guesses.

name: TierDrop
desc: A new tier list every day. Place items into tiers, and debate with friends! See how close you were to the rest of your world by viewing the results the next day!

name: Tilt
desc: A daily weighing game: one thing sits on a balance scale and you guess how many of something else it takes to balance it, like how many honeybees weigh as much as a horse.

name: tiltanic
desc: A new sea every day with a daily board. Tilt your phone or move the mouse. A tiny steamboat rides the wave through anchors and mines.

name: Timed
desc: Time estimation game with no clock. You are asked for an interval - 4.3 seconds, say. You press and hold, and the screen goes dark. Let go when you think the time is up.

name: Tipoff
desc: Daily sports photo game. Every day everyone gets the same three real photos, from 1890s baseball to last season. For each one, drop a pin on the stadium, slide to the year, and name the player or team, all against a 90-second shot clock. Covers basketball, football, baseball, soccer, tennis, boxing, hockey and more, across college, pro and international sports.

name: TubeCount
desc: Guess how many views a real YouTube video got from its thumbnail. Daily puzzle with 3 guesses (title and channel unlock as clues), plus a higher/lower streak mode and a 5-round Binge mode with shareable challenge links.

name: TypeCircuit
desc: TypeCircuit is a daily typing game. Type as fast and accurately as possible to complete the circuit and aim for the highest WPM (Words Per Minute) score.

name: Unicorner
desc: Daily football trivia game where the obvious answer is the worst answer. Your mission is to name players who fit the prompt but who nobody else will think of.

name: Unlabeled
desc: A daily puzzle. Four charts have lost their axis labels. Put them back in four tries.

name: Viralguessr
desc: Viral Video Guesser Game. Guess which video is more popular! How long of a streak can you get?

name: Vroomdle
desc: Vroomdle is a free daily car guessing game inspired by Wordle. Every day a new mystery car is chosen from a database of 499+ models.

name: Wallstreetle
desc: Solve the daily stock ticker with real charts, financial metrics, and guided hints across SPY, Tech, NASDAQ, WallStreetBets, and more.

name: WasThatBefore
desc: WasThatBefore is a free daily timeline puzzle where you're given 5 historical events and have to put them in the correct chronological order. Global puzzles, country-specific, and even some state-specific.

name: WC Time Machine
desc: A daily football draft game spanning 80 years of World Cups, where Pelé, Maradona and Mbappé can line up on the same XI. Everyone drafts from the same seeded squads each day, then battles through the group stage and knockouts to win!

name: Whale-a-day
desc: You are a traveler arrived at Ravenswood Bluff. It's people are slain. Use your deduction skills to find out who the townsfolk truly were.

name: When?
desc: Guess when a real event happened by placing it on a timeline.

name: Whenere
desc: Daily trivia game to guess when and where an event took place

name: Who Are Ya?
desc: Guess the hidden footballer in this football wordle game. Each guess reveals attributes about the player.

name: Who Gets What
desc: A real price and the people paid out of it. Split it, then see the real figures.

name: Who Started?
desc: Daily college football game. A future star sat on the bench. Name the QB who started over him.

name: Who's That?
desc: Guess the footballer behind a blurred photo. The picture sharpens with every wrong guess, and hints on league, nation, position, age and team unlock as you go.

name: Whodle
desc: Can you identify the famous person from their attributes?

name: WhoHadMore
desc: WhoHadMore is a daily higher/lower game with unique topic every day. Compete to earn your spot on the daily leaderboard by completing the game with as few errors as possible.

name: Wordlecup
desc: A free daily Wordle-like game where players guess the hidden player using clues like club, league, nation, position, age, height, number, etc. Choose between football (soccer), basketball, and NFL modes.

name: Yearbook
desc: Each day a random year between 1950 and 2025 is chosen. You are given 4 clues from different categories — world events, pop culture, politics, and more — ordered vaguest to most specific. Can you guess the year?

name: Yeardle
desc: Daily "Guess the Year" History Game. Given a historical fact, guess the year it happened. Depending on how close your guess is, the tile will light up with a different color.

name: Years Apart
desc: Two real events and one in between. Slide it to where it falls, then see the years.

name: Yesternerd
desc: Four daily history games: name the face or artifact behind a torn portrait in as few tears as possible, guess the historical figure from when and where they were born and died, and sort 16 tiles into four hidden groups.

name: Your Call
desc: A real moment from history and three choices. Make your call, then see what the leader actually did. One moment a day.
